scripts.predev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const dest1='public/admin/blueprints/assets'; const dest2='public/admin/inspection/reports/assets'; fs.mkdirSync(dest1, {recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync(dest2, {recursive:true}); try { fs.cpSync('node_modules/@mlightcad/mtext-renderer/dist', dest1, {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('node_modules/@mlightcad/mtext-renderer/dist', dest2, {recursive:true}); } catch(e) { console.log('Worker kopyalama atlandi...'); }"
scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try { fs.rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch(e) { }"
scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const dst='public/wasm'; fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); try{ fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc.wasm', dst+'/web-ifc.wasm'); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc-mt.wasm', dst+'/web-ifc-mt.wasm'); console.log('WASM Kopyalandi!'); }catch(e){console.error('WASM Hata:',e);}" && next build --webpack
scripts.postinstall: prisma generate && prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node patch-ifc-viewer.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const dst='public/wasm'; fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); try{ fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc.wasm', dst+'/web-ifc.wasm'); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc-mt.wasm', dst+'/web-ifc-mt.wasm'); console.log('✅ WASM files copied to public/wasm/'); }catch(e){ console.log('⚠️ WASM copy failed:',e.message); }"
